subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column ‘A’ ‘B’ and ‘C’ to write five complete sentences. 1  5 =
stimulus: Column 'A' Column 'B' Column 'C' (a) Wild life i. is one of the reasons of the extinction i. day by day. (b) The wild animals ii. should be saved ii. of many animals. (c) Many wild animals iii. is essential for maintaining iii. for our own safety. (d) Man's greed iv. have extricated iv. ecological balance. (e) Wild creatures v. are decreasing v. from the world.
guide_solution: (a) Wild life is essential for maintaining ecological balance. (b) The wild animals are decreasing day by day. (c) Many wild animals have extricated from the world. (d) Man's greed is one of the reasons of the extinction of many animals. (e) Wild creatures should be saved for our own safety.
